answer.summary: The procedure debits a specified amount from the account balance and the cycle balance. It constructs a transaction record with a generated ID and writes it to the transaction output file, while also updating internal counters for reporting.

rules.text: The account balance (KTO_SLD) is increased by the transaction amount (B#BTR).
The cycle balance (KTO_ZYK_SOL) is increased by the transaction amount (B#BTR).
The transaction ID (TRN_ID) is constructed by concatenating the prefix (B#PFX), the account number (KTO_NR), and the literal string '000'.
The transaction source (TRN_QUELLE) is set to the literal string 'ZINSLAUF'.
The transaction handler (TRN_HDL) is set to the literal string '000000000'.
The transaction MCC code (TRN_MCC) is set to the literal string '0000'.
The transaction card number (TRN_KARTE) is set to an empty string.
The transaction date (TRN_DT) is set to the current run date (W_LAUFDT).
The booking record (BUC_SATZ) is initialized to an empty string.
The booking transaction field (BUC_TRN) is populated with the first 110 characters of the transaction record (TRN_SATZ).
The booking account number (BUC_KTO) is set to the account number (KTO_NR).
The booking date (BUC_DT) is set to the current run date (W_LAUFDT).
The booking record (BUC_SATZ) is written to the TRANOUT file.
The procedure KBU00027 is called with the transaction type (B#TYP), amount (B#BTR), and the literal status 'E'.
